propositions: Python 3.11 pathlib.Path.rglob caches directory entries and raises FileNotFoundError when a cached child directory vanishes before descent, whereas Python 3.12+ tolerates the same concurrent removal via walk-based traversal

The fixture _remove_readonly_run_snapshots recursively descended into unrelated mutable subtrees including the canonical tracker write lock directory, which was concurrently removed by LockHandle.release() at a deterministic post-scandir barrier, reproducing the exact failure

Ambient Path(dirpath) factory calls during test teardown consult the live os.name value and raise NotImplementedError when a test monkeypatches os.name='nt' before cleanup, selecting WindowsPath on a POSIX system

The repair must retain recursive exact-root .rebar/run_snapshots discovery, tolerate only FileNotFoundError for vanished entries via os.walk(..., onerror=...), re-raise all other walk errors, and avoid ambient Path construction during test-scoped monkeypatch lifetime
